verification.note: YouTube metadata: uploaded 2026-10-16 by Ben Cera, description '$20M ARR as a Solo Founder'; transcript: 'I'm now in San Francisco at a $20 million run rate', 'I did it all as a solo founder', 'In September... by the end of the month, I hit a $20 million run rate', 'By June I was at an 11 million...cut the price from $50 to $20...In one month, I went from 11 million to 8 million', 'We've pulled more engineers into the product...help me with...bugs', 'Their engineers came in to help fix the bugs and harden the platform', 'more than a million dollars a month on AI'. Corrected: removed unsourced 'a month' on the price cut and the self-contradictory 'neither says it is recurring' gloss; auto-captions render the partner as 'Sapium', so added Sapiom CEO's LinkedIn post ('Polsia runs on Sapiom') to support the name. Not a duplicate: status update of the May 22 run-rate event.
